title: Where to Buy a French Bulldog: Breeders, Rescues and Red Flags
seoTitle: Where to Buy a French Bulldog Safely
description: Where to buy a French Bulldog: how to find a responsible breeder, the health tests to ask for, why rare colors are a red flag and how to adopt from a rescue.
primaryKeyword: where to buy a french bulldog
secondaryKeywords: how to find a good french bulldog breeder

faq.q: How do I find a good French Bulldog breeder?
faq.a: The French Bull Dog Club of America suggests going to dog shows, talking with breeders and contacting breeders on its referral list, who have agreed to its Code of Ethics.

faq.q: What health tests should the parents have?
faq.a: For a CHIC number the FBDCA requires hip, eye (CAER), patella and heart evaluations registered with OFA, plus permanent ID.

faq.q: Are rare-color French Bulldogs worth the price?
faq.a: The French Bulldog Rescue Network warns that 'rare' or 'designer' colors are non-standard colors often sold at inflated prices, and some carry known health risks.

faq.q: Can I adopt a French Bulldog?
faq.a: Yes. Breed rescues such as the French Bulldog Rescue Network place French Bulldogs that need new homes.
